name: WAV → MP3 192 kbps
description: Create MP3 listening or delivery copies from WAV files.
caveat: Creates new MP3s; never changes WAVs.

name: WAV → mono 48 kHz
caveat: Downmixes channels. Check the result before delivery.

name: WAV → 44.1 kHz / 16-bit
description: Convert sample rate and bit depth into separate WAV copies.
caveat: This alters technical format, not mastering quality.

name: Volume / peak report
description: Inspect mean and maximum sample volume in audio files.
caveat: Not an integrated-loudness or true-peak test.

name: Silence report
description: Find candidate silent sections for editing review.
caveat: Uses a -45 dBFS threshold for at least one second.

name: Extract audio from video
description: Turn MP4, MOV and MKV soundtracks into 48 kHz WAV copies.
caveat: Retains the video; never modifies it.

name: Clean trailing spaces
description: Create UTF-8 TXT and Markdown copies without trailing line spaces.
caveat: Do not use on DOCX or non-UTF-8 source files.

name: Word-count CSV
description: Count approximate words and characters in plain text files.

name: Folder inventory CSV
description: Export a file list with paths, sizes, formats and dates.
caveat: Recursively scans subfolders; does not rename anything.

name: Exact-duplicate finder
description: Find byte-identical files by comparing SHA-256 hashes.
caveat: Never deletes files; can be slow on large collections.

name: Image dimensions CSV
description: Report width and height of JPG and PNG images.
